name: Gut Horn
beschreibung: The campsite Gut Horn is located in Waging am See, in the Rupertiwinkel near the border with Tirol. The surroundings are shaped by Waginger See and the Chiemgauer Alpen. The site is characterized by a quiet, close-to-nature atmosphere. Amenities include pitches with electricity and water connections, sanitary facilities, a restaurant, as well as an indoor pool and a sauna. Hiking trails are accessible directly from the site, and several ski areas can be reached within a short drive. Guests can expect a combination of a swimming holiday by the lake and activities in the mountains.
